title: Integrity Verification
subtitle: Recalculate every entry hash and locate the first broken sequence.

hero.title: Verify the global audit chain
hero.description: Each ledger row includes its canonical data, previous hash pointer, and SHA-256 digest.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: This checks the protected audit ledger for altered entries and broken hash links. Entries covered by a blockchain anchor below carry independent, publicly verifiable proof they existed unchanged since anchor time; anything after the most recent anchor still relies on this database alone until the next one runs.

anchors.title: Blockchain-anchored proof
anchors.description: Periodically commits the audit chain's current hash to a public blockchain, so no one with database access alone can rewrite history undetected.
anchors.notConfigured: Blockchain anchoring is not configured on this server. An administrator can enable it to make the audit chain independently verifiable outside this database.
